description: Delete a SAVED playable from a TikTok advertiser's Creative Library. Permanent. Without confirm:true it changes nothing and returns what would be deleted, which you show the user first. TikTok does not report which ads use it.

advertiserId.description: TikTok ad account id from list_tiktok_ads_accounts; omit when only one account is shared with this profile

confirmName.description: optional name check for the playable being deleted; confirm:true is the gate

name: delete_tiktok_ads_playable
title: Delete a TikTok playable
